lipstick.text: Shade is exactly like the swatch on the listing. Stayed through lunch, only needed a touch up after.
lipstick.author: Ritika S.

lipstick.text: Colour is good but it dries the lips a little. I put balm underneath and then it is fine.
lipstick.author: Anjali M.

lipstick.text: On my pigmented lips this looked much darker than the photo. Not the seller's fault but be warned.
lipstick.author: Shweta P.

lipstick.text: Bought after seeing a creator use it. Same shade arrived, that was the main thing for me.
lipstick.author: Priya K.

lipstick.text: Decent for the price. Transfers on cups which the listing does not mention.
lipstick.author: Neha R.

lipstick.text: Two coats needed for the colour in the picture. One coat is more like a tint.
lipstick.author: Divya T.

lipstick.text: Received a different shade from what I ordered. Returned it without any trouble though.
lipstick.author: Kavya B.

lipstick.text: Lightweight, does not feel sticky. I wear it to college daily.
lipstick.author: Megha J.

lipstick.text: Suits my skin better than the brighter reds I own. Daylight photo on the listing helped me decide.
lipstick.author: Sanya V.

lipstick.text: Good colour, but the applicator is too wide for the cupid's bow.
lipstick.author: Pooja N.

eyeshadow.text: Pigment is strong, one dip is enough. Blends without patches.
eyeshadow.author: Ritika S.

eyeshadow.text: The matte shades are better than the shimmer ones, which have some fallout.
eyeshadow.author: Anjali M.

eyeshadow.text: Chalky on my skin tone. Needed a primer to show up at all.
eyeshadow.author: Shweta P.

eyeshadow.text: Lasted a full wedding function without creasing.
eyeshadow.author: Priya K.

eyeshadow.text: Colour payoff is fine but the pan is smaller than it looks in the photo.
eyeshadow.author: Neha R.

eyeshadow.text: Good everyday neutral. Not a dupe for the expensive one but close enough.
eyeshadow.author: Divya T.

eyeshadow.text: Shimmer catches light nicely in photos, looks subtle in person.
eyeshadow.author: Megha J.

eyeshadow.text: Fallout under the eyes every time. Do your eyes before your base.
eyeshadow.author: Sanya V.

nail.text: Two coats and it is opaque. Dried fast enough that I did not smudge it.
nail.author: Ritika S.

nail.text: Colour is accurate. Chipped at the tips around day four.
nail.author: Anjali M.

nail.text: Streaky in the first coat and needed three to look even.
nail.author: Shweta P.

nail.text: Brush is wide so it covers the nail in two strokes. Good for the price.
nail.author: Priya K.

nail.text: Shiny when fresh but loses the gloss after a day without top coat.
nail.author: Neha R.

nail.text: Darker than it looks on screen, which I actually preferred.
nail.author: Divya T.

nail.text: Bottle arrived half spilled inside the packet.
nail.author: Kavya B.

nail.text: Holds up through dishes and washing if you add a top coat.
nail.author: Megha J.

hair.text: Covered my greys fully. Colour matched the box on my hair.
hair.author: Ritika S.

hair.text: Good coverage but it faded to a lighter tone after about four washes.
hair.author: Anjali M.

hair.text: On dark hair this barely showed. You need to bleach first for the shade in the photo.
hair.author: Shweta P.

hair.text: No itching or smell issues for me. Did a patch test first as instructed.
hair.author: Priya K.

hair.text: The tube quantity is not enough for long hair. Order two.
hair.author: Neha R.

hair.text: Came out slightly warmer than the box but still close.
hair.author: Divya T.

hair.text: Hair felt soft after, the conditioner sachet helps.
hair.author: Megha J.

hair.text: Stained my forehead, use cream along the hairline before applying.
hair.author: Sanya V.

lipstick.creator: supriya.beauty
lipstick.liked: Colour on camera matched what arrived. Comfortable for the first few hours.
lipstick.disliked: Settles into lip lines by hour four and it does transfer onto cups.

lipstick.creator: ananya.makes
lipstick.liked: Even coverage in two coats and the applicator reaches the corners.
lipstick.disliked: Reads warmer indoors than it does outside, so check both before deciding.

lipstick.creator: pooja.shades
lipstick.liked: A calmer version of the brighter shades in this range, good for daily wear.
lipstick.disliked: Too sheer in one coat if you have pigmented lips.

lipstick.creator: farah.lipdiary
lipstick.liked: Holds its colour on deeper skin instead of going ashy.
lipstick.disliked: Drying by the end of the day, needs balm underneath.

eyeshadow.creator: nidhi.glow
eyeshadow.coats: Packed on with a flat brush
eyeshadow.liked: Strong pigment, one dip covers the lid.
eyeshadow.disliked: The shimmer has noticeable fallout, do eyes before base.

eyeshadow.creator: ananya.makes
eyeshadow.liked: Blends out without patchiness and the mattes do not go chalky.
eyeshadow.disliked: Needs a primer to last past six hours on oily lids.

eyeshadow.creator: farah.lipdiary
eyeshadow.liked: Shows up clearly on deeper skin without needing a white base.
eyeshadow.disliked: Pan is small for the price.

nail.creator: pooja.shades
nail.liked: Opaque in two coats and dries quicker than most at this price.
nail.disliked: Chips at the tips by day four without a top coat.

nail.creator: nidhi.glow
nail.liked: Holds gloss for about a week when a top coat is used.
nail.disliked: First coat goes on streaky, you have to commit to the second.

hair.creator: supriya.beauty
hair.liked: Grey coverage was complete on the first application.
hair.disliked: Faded about two shades by the fourth week.

hair.creator: farah.lipdiary
hair.liked: Matched the existing length well, no obvious line at the roots.
hair.disliked: On unbleached dark hair the shade in the box is not achievable.
